title: Act: Ignore node_modules at any depth and untrack it
description: Add node_modules/ to .gitignore and remove tracked node_modules from the index, keeping files on disk.
acceptance_criteria: Given .gitignore, then a node_modules/ line exists
Given the index, then no node_modules path is tracked
technical_constraints: Use git rm --cached only; do not delete from disk
definition_of_done: node_modules/ ignored; git ls-files has no node_modules paths

steps.action: Append the line node_modules/ after game/node_modules/ so node_modules at any depth is ignored.
Run git rm -r --cached -q game/frontend/node_modules to untrack vendored files while leaving them on disk, resolving the UU vitest results.json conflict.
steps.expected: git ls-files | grep node_modules prints nothing
